name: notch receptor 3

function.text: NOTCH3 encodes neurogenic locus notch homolog protein 3 [Cleaved into: Notch 3 extracellular truncation; Notch 3 intracellular domain]. Annotated molecular activities include signaling receptor activity and cadherin binding. It participates in positive regulation of miRNA transcription and axon guidance.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include cerebral arteriopathy, autosomal dominant, with subcortical infarcts and leukoencephalopathy, type 1 (autosomal dominant); cerebral arteriopathy, autosomal recessive, with subcortical infarcts and leukoencephalopathy 1 (autosomal recessive). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.
